digitals.description: Digitals are standard neutral-background agency photos — front-facing, profile, 3/4 turn, and full body. Natural light, no styling, no filters.
digitals.requiredNote: All four shots are required. Clear, natural light, no filters.
digitals.fileRequirements: JPG or PNG · Max 10MB per image · Minimum 800px on shortest side
digitals.privacyNotice: Photos stored securely in EU-West (Ireland) · Never used for model training · Deletable anytime
digitals.errorAtLeastOne: Upload at least one digital to continue.
digitals.completeLater: You can complete missing digitals later.
